notes.title: Upcoming Updates & Improvements
notes.content:
Upcoming Updates for Knight of Justice
The next update for Knight of Justice is coming soon in early October!

We’re adding Simplified and Traditional Chinese language support. （感谢玩家的回馈，我们将在下次更新增加简体中文和繁体中文的支持！）

Visual improvements and environment design updates are also on the way.

Graphics Settings Bug (Temporary Notice): Currently, the Low graphics setting is applying High quality, and High is applying Low quality. This bug has already been fixed and the correction will be included in the next major update.

In addition, the Original Soundtrack will be released next month! 🎵

Stay connected:

Follow us on X (Twitter) for the latest news and updates.

Join our Discord to share feedback, discuss the game, and take part in our future giveaway events. (Link available on our Steam store page or at the bottom of this post.)

Thank you all for your amazing support — it means the world to us! 💙
— StarFlow Studio

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 – Tutorial & UI Fixes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1

Fixed an issue with the Defeat UI displaying incorrectly.
Fixed a tutorial mission bug: players will now correctly receive the mission to buy units from the blacksmith NPC before the first defense mission.
